name: Aberdeen
notes: Condominium and apartment complexes are not collected by the township; ask your homeowners' association.
Put garbage out no earlier than 4 pm the night before and take the pails in as soon as you can after pickup.
Recycling goes in one container, no plastic bags: glass, cans, plastic bottles #1 and #2, newspaper, cardboard and mixed paper. Bundle or bag paper in paper bags.
Bulk: two items per pickup on your second garbage day; mattresses wrapped in plastic. No TVs or computers at the curb; take them to the Public Works yard, 147 Lenox Rd.
Brush and branches: Section I the weeks of April 20 and September 21, Section II the weeks of April 27 and September 28, out by Monday morning.
Leaves: by neighborhood, one week each from October 12 to December 7; see the township's Fall Leaf Pick-Up Schedule. Grass clippings are not picked up.
When New Year's Day, Thanksgiving or Christmas falls on your day, pickup is on your next scheduled day.
sources: 2026 Community Calendar, Trash & Recycling Pick-Up Schedule for Single-Family Residences: https://www.aberdeennj.org/DocumentCenter/View/3686
